renderer_investigation.question: What is the smallest production path for native PS4 drawing of G3dSnapshot data while preserving the current CPU fallback and DS composition semantics?
scope: engine/platform/plat_gl3d.c and engine/platform/plat_sdlgpu3d.c feature and fallback behavior
demo/eidos_boot.c PS4 and generic GPU frame paths
engine/platform/ps4/video_ps4.cpp GNMX resources and command submission
evidence: G3dSnapshot owns transformed clip-space vertices, indices, polygons, decoded texture copies, and DS render state.
GL and SDL GPU backends consume G3dSnapshot and report supported frame features through g3d_hw_gpu_features; unsupported frames retain CPU rasterization.
The PS4 boot path does not create EidosPlatform: boot_render_ps4 calls g2d_hw_render_dsmem and draws the resulting 256x192 DS images through a final GNMX compatibility pass.

The official SDK sample archive includes GNMX vertex-buffer, vertex-shader, depth-target, indexed-draw, and submit examples; the current PS4 backend only binds pixel shaders for fullscreen compatibility passes.
renderer_investigation.decision: Keep the PS4 frame path and CPU rasterizer intact while prototyping a dedicated GNMX snapshot adapter. Do not advertise snapshot features as GPU-supported or enable raster skipping until feature coverage and fallback boundaries are proven.
missing_evidence: Official PSSL vertex shader plus fetch/input layout compiled and linked in the PS4 target.
GNMX depth and per-polygon state translation with an explicit supported-feature classifier.
Physical-console capture confirming the native draw and correct DS composition.
renderer_investigation.next_experiment: Build an isolated GNMX draw of snapshot-derived opaque untextured triangles into an offscreen 256x192 target, keeping CPU output authoritative. Add source-derived vertex conversion checks and compile/link with SDK 12.508 before any game-path connection.
renderer_investigation.effort_budget: One bounded implementation checkpoint; stop after the isolated target build and conversion evidence, or record the exact SDK/API blocker and next discriminating check.
renderer_investigation.stopping_condition: Do not connect the prototype to game presentation or enable g3d_hw_skip_raster until target compile/link succeeds, converted vertices are covered by tests, unsupported content is detected, and physical capture validates the draw.
